en.help_tooltip: This screen allows you to check on the other ants who live nearby, both Outsiders and other Colony ants. You can control how the monarch of your Colony will treat other monarchs at Gatherings, but keep in mind that you can only determine one interaction each moon! Likewise, you can consider whether to drive out or invite in Outsider ants. If you drive out an ant, they will no longer appear in the Ants Outside the Colonies list. If you invite an ant in, they might join your Clan!
